thread:
maya: Ran a quick sweep comparing our fused-attn variant vs paged-attn with fp8 quant, results look... weird.
jon: show numbers?
maya: baseline fused (bf16) 1.0x, fused(fp8, q4) 0.74x latency but error rate up ~0.9% on QA prompts. paged(fp8) 0.81x latency and only 0.2% error.
sasha: by error do you mean token-level divergence or softmax NaNs?
maya: token divergence. no NaNs in logs, but logits tail blows up occasionally -> different greedy picks.
jon: any repro scripts?
maya: yes, uploaded a tiny harness in the run artifacts: `bin/run_attention_scan --model gpt-small --mode compare --quant fp8 --kernels fused,paged --seed 42 --prompt-file tests/qa_prompts.txt`
tara: is KV warmup the same between runs? paged vs fused have different KV prefetch heuristics right now.
maya: good call — I forced cold KV for both. but I also have a warm profile where fused keeps a tiny residual and paged coldstarts. cold/cold gave the divergence pattern.
jon: can you paste a short stack/log sample where logits spike?
maya: sure:
```
[2024-06-12T15:21:02Z] fused_attn.cu:WARN kernel=flash_fused_qdq: max_logit=1.2e3
[2024-06-12T15:21:02Z] softmax.cu:INFO replaced_scale=1.0e-4
[2024-06-12T15:21:02Z] decode: token=49807 prob=9.1e-300 -> underflow clamp
```
jon: 1.2e3 is suspicious. where is scaling coming from? overflow in qk?
sasha: fp8 exponent range is tiny; is the fused path doing a different pre-scale than paged?
maya: I instrumented qk scale: fused uses rscale from kernel heuristics: 1e-2, paged uses dynamic maxnorm scaling to 1e-4. that explains big logits.
tara: then the numerical path differs. we should normalize upstream for both kernels before softmax.
jon: quick patch suggestion: apply max-abs clamp on QK / sqrt(dk) with a fallback scaling factor computed from a small subtree reduction (topk approx). cheap to compute?
sasha: we already have a light pre-reduction in paged. fused avoided it for perf. adding tiny reduction may cost ~3% perf but fix numeric regressions.
maya: ran an experiment: fused + one-shot maxabs reduce costs 2% latency but removes 0.85% error. new numbers: fused(fp8,pre-reduce) 0.76x latency, 0.05% error.
jon: good tradeoff. can you file a perf/regression ticket and include the harness + artifact link?
maya: filed: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4872 with perf table and logs.
jon: schedule A/B rollout with canary to dedicated pool. add a kernel selector flag `numeric_safe=true` default off for now.
tara: also update batching heuristics: when batch size > 16, preferring paged for fp8 might hide the problem. need policy: if fp8 && small-seq && small-batch -> use fused+pre-reduce; else use paged.
sasha: agree. I'll prototype selector rules.
infra-bot: deploy job queued: `deploy/kernels/patch-1719001234` to canary cluster.
maya: thanks — I'll watch traces. adding eval sweep for hallucination metrics too. :eyes: 
jon: nice. after canary, we should run long-tail prompts to check for rare spikes.
maya: yep scheduling a 48h continuous run. will post updates. :rocket:
